examples.name: The answer to the great question of life, the universe and everything is 42

Rewriting an open task to the **in-review** status leaves the box open, which is "true". Rewriting an open task to the **in-review** status inserts the in-review slug, which is "true". Rewriting any task to **done** collapses it to a checked box with no worked flag, which is "true"
Marking an unflagged open task as worked-today inserts the `> ` flag, so afterwards the flag is "present"

When a note rolls forward to the next day, the date advances by one **weekday**, skipping weekends. Rolling forward from Friday 2026-08-28 lands on "2026-08-31". Rolling forward from Monday 2026-08-31 lands on "2026-09-01". The date 2026-08-28 is a Friday, which is "true"
Adding a task to the Tasks section appends a new open checkbox line, so afterwards the new line is "present"
